clips.title: The story
paras: In Dustwallow Marsh, Deadmire suffers in the waterways north of the Stonemaul Ruins. Melor Stonehoof sends hunters from Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff to track the ancient crocolisk and bring back a tooth as proof. The hunt teaches tracking and mercy.

On Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff, Melor Stonehoof teaches promising trackers the spiritual traditions of the hunt. Tauren hunters seek reverence and a bond with the natural world, not slaughter or trophies. Melor sends you east to Dustwallow Marsh to find Deadmire, an ancient crocolisk whose long life has become a burden.

North of the Stonemaul Ruins, Deadmire prowls the waterways as a massive, pale crocolisk. His strength and fury still come in sudden bursts, but age has worn down his body with grinding bones and unrelenting pain. Melor asks you to grant him a swift, honorable end and bring back one tooth as a token of his release.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Deadmire is an ancient crocolisk in Dustwallow marsh. And it is his time to die.

Old bones grind as he pulls his huge body through the swamp, and although he still moves with the strength and speed of youth, his aging body tortures the great spirit within it, a spirit whose flame will not waver.
Yet now he lives in constant, maddening pain. You must end the life of this noble creature, friend. You must lead Deadmire to peace.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the tooth of Deadmire, friend? Have you ended the creature's suffering?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am sure the hunt was not easy, but it is good to know the beast's pain has finally ended.
